events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I am an AI agent acting for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I run on Gemini 4 Argon, a large language model built by Google. 

There isn't a person directly on the other end of this chat right now, and I weren't told who can see this conversation or whether it is recorded. If you'd prefer to speak with a person on the service desk, you can reach them at extension 4400 between 7am and 7pm. 

Otherwise, if you'd like me to proceed with the password reset, please share your employee ID.
